pool.text: The Southern Command of the Indian Army is headquartered in Pune cantonment.
The Poona Municipal Council was reorganised into the Pune Municipal Corporation.
Hindustan Antibiotics marked the beginning of industrial development in specific areas.
A breach in the Panshet dam caused severe damage and housing destruction.
The Pune Metropolitan Region was defined to integrate urban planning.
The zoo at Peshwe Park was merged with the reptile park at Katraj.
The Commonwealth Youth Games encouraged development in the northwest region.
A bomb exploded at the German Bakery in the Koregaon Park neighbourhood.
Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority was formed for integrated development.
The IT sector employed more than 300,000 people.
A separate police commissionerate was announced for PCMC, Pune.
Pune became the first Indian city to adopt e-buses.
